g1.label: 1. losing popularity — I think it ___
g1.why: 'I think' plus a prediction takes will + infinitive.

g2.label: 2. already announced the plan — next term they ___
g2.why: 'Going to' is used for a plan already decided before speaking.

g3.label: 3. According to my calendar, I ___
g3.why: The present progressive states a fixed personal arrangement.

g4.label: 4. By the end of this year, researchers ___
g4.why: Future perfect: 'will have' + past participle for something finished by a future point.

g5.label: 5. This time next week, teenagers ___
g5.why: Future progressive: 'will be' + -ing for an action in progress at a future time.

g6.label: 6. Experts believe that in ten years, platforms ___
g6.why: A prediction about the distant future takes will + infinitive.

g7.label: 7. look at those figures, she ___
g7.why: 'Going to' expresses a prediction based on present evidence you can see.

g8.label: 8. By next summer, many students ___
g8.why: Future perfect progressive stresses how long an action will have gone on by a future point.

g1.label: 1. time spent on a device
g1.why: Screen time is the total time spent using a phone, tablet or computer.

g2.label: 2. a deliberate period without devices
g2.why: A digital detox is a planned break from digital devices.

g3.label: 3. rules deciding what content to show
g3.why: An algorithm is the set of rules a platform uses to select content.

g4.label: 4. scrolling through upsetting content
g4.why: Doomscrolling is compulsively reading negative content online.

g5.label: 5. feeling you are missing out
g5.why: FOMO stands for 'fear of missing out'.

g6.label: 6. mainly meeting similar opinions
g6.why: In an echo chamber you mostly hear views like your own.

g7.label: 7. large following, paid to promote
g7.why: An influencer is paid to promote products to a large following.

g8.label: 8. trail of data left online
g8.why: Your digital footprint is the data trail your online activity leaves.
